correctness.rationale: The signed generating function obeys T(z)=(1-z)T(z²). Its self-convolution satisfies C(2m)=C(m)+C(m-1) and C(2m+1)=-2C(m), hence at even n≥4, |C(4m)| and |C(4m+2)| are bounded by 2m+1, with ratio at most 3/5 to n+1 and equality only at n=4. C(2)=-1. Repeated trailing-one stripping preserves normalized absolute size, yielding exact equality indices 5·2^j−1 and Mersenne values. The indicator identity R=(n+1-C)/4 proves all statements. Direct computational replay verifies 524288 recurrence cases and 2049 independent digit-parity convolutions; finite checks are supplementary.
